citation: Classified advertisement, the rental agent 'Brinkman, 2105 Indiana-av.'. Chicago Sunday Tribune, 31 January 1904 (vol. 63 no. 5).
author: Chicago Sunday Tribune
locator: The issue's OCR text (per_chicago-daily-tribune_1904-01-31_63_5), the classified columns; the OCR runs neighbouring advertisements together, so only the words quoted in the note are read from it.
rights_note: A United States newspaper of 1904; public domain.

note: A rental agent, Brinkman, giving 2105 Indiana Avenue as the agent's address in January 1904; the same agent signs ads from that address through March 1908.
what_it_supplies: that 2105 Indiana Avenue was occupied, as an agent's office address, from January 1904 to 1908
